meta.name: offensive-fuzzing
meta.description: Practical offensive fuzzing methodology covering target identification, fuzzer selection (AFL++, libFuzzer, Honggfuzz, Boofuzz, syzkaller), harness writing, corpus curation, mutation strategies, coverage measurement, and crash triage. Use when setting up or running fuzz campaigns against any target: file parsers, network protocols, kernel drivers, EDR engines, embedded firmware, or language runtimes.

copy.tagline_en: Fuzz targets to discover security vulnerabilities

howto.when: 当你需要测试软件或系统（如文件解析器、网络协议、内核驱动）的安全性，寻找潜在漏洞时触发。
